en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a large, ornate, rectangular school building with classical architectural details, multiple chimneys, and tall windows. In front of the building stands a group of schoolchildren and adults, some gathered around a wooden gymnastic frame; another person is on a long ladder leaning against the building. The scene appears to be in an open yard or school grounds. Printed caption text is in the upper left corner.
